property_summary: For every successful payable fallback call sending exactly 10 ether at a strictly later block.timestamp than the stored pastBlockTime, the contract records pastBlockTime equal to the current block.timestamp; the mutant that writes block.number instead will make pastBlockTime != block.timestamp for some inputs (when block.number != block.timestamp).
change_summary: Change pastBlockTime update to use block.number instead of block.timestamp, altering the recorded state and subsequent behavior.
